title: V5 train-only paired gradient calibration, executable acceptance protocol
purpose: Measure one independently derived physics gradient scale for each weak test basis at frozen Stage-1 weights while proving identical training windows, coordinates, and collocation samples across the pair.

data_partition.partition_rule: Filter has_noaa_mapping, sort by t0, and take rows before split index 28405.

pre_measurement_hash_gate.failure_action: abort before any frame read or model measurement
required_before: focused calibration tests on the pod
pre_measurement_hash_gate.tool_internal_gate: The calibration tool independently requires and verifies config, checkpoint, train-validation parquet, window-spec, and consolidated-manifest hashes before opening the windows table, constructing the frame dataset, or measuring the model.

basis_specific_diagnostics.reason: Diagnostics include the weak test basis, matched test-pair counts, and raw weak-moment magnitudes. They are not basis-invariant evidence.

freeze_gate: This protocol authorizes calibration measurement and pair acceptance only. It does not authorize an efficacy configuration, efficacy training, validation evaluation, test access, seed runs, or any optimizer update.
prohibited: Creating or freezing any efficacy configuration from this protocol.
Launching efficacy training or applying any optimizer update.
Reading validation examples or predictive outputs during calibration.
Reading, listing, hashing, opening, or downloading any test artifact.
Pooling gradient measurements across weak test bases.
Requiring equality of basis-specific diagnostics digests.
Accepting a pair with mismatched identity, coordinate, sampling, state, or pinned-input evidence.
Changing a pinned artifact, index, seed, target, lambda, basis order, formula, or gate after measurement begins.
